title: ENCI geological section

source.title: Witteveen+Bos / Rijkswaterstaat — Technische variantenstudie laagwaterbuffer ENCI-groeve

note: 2024 report regional reference bands; schematic horizontal contacts, not local measured strata. Maastricht top is described as +75 m in regional REGIS section and +90 m in quarry description; transition is uncertain. Original cover ~15 m (loess, sand, gravel), partly deposited at D’n Observant. Present backfill and disturbed cover not mapped. 2007 report gives Gulpen base ~−35 m, versus ~−45 m in 2024 report; regional contact varies.

layers.name: Gulpen Formation
layers.description: Soft fine-grained limestone. Regional contact varies; 2007 reference base −35 m.

layers.name: Maastricht Formation
layers.description: Alternating hard and soft light-grey limestones. Regional reference.

layers.name: Maastricht upper contact · uncertain
layers.description: 2024 pp. 12–13 describe +75 and +90 m tops in different contexts; not a distinct geological formation.

layers.name: Cover / disturbed ground · unmapped
layers.description: Original cover ~15 m of loess, sand and gravel. Boxtel Formation occurs locally at surface; original cover partly deposited at D’n Observant. No local fill geometry or actual thickness inferred.

memberNote: Regional stratigraphic order, top to bottom; local presence and absolute elevations not assigned.
